decision: In-game prop: a broken concrete wall for Snow Fortress, generated from a reference image by TRELLIS.2 (same generator as the crashed helicopter). It is a closed object with depth (relief 0.68) authored to be seen from any angle, so it is a mesh prop, not a skybox or terrain. Built by scene_kit at 20 studs long (about 15.7 tall, 14 deep including the rubble apron) with a bottom pivot, decimated to 9,000 triangles in one mesh. The verdict above says to tile; that was overridden deliberately for the same reason as the helicopter: it is a compact object seen from outside, and the 9,000-triangle render keeps the stepped broken top, the block courses and the rubble at the foot, so one mesh beats several. Textures arrived as 2048 WebP, which Roblox cannot read, so gltf_post converts them to 1024 PNG. The base colour is tinted (0.60, 0.58, 0.56, lift 0.03) because the source is near-white and would vanish against the snowfield, and a MeshPart Color does not tint an applied texture. Placed as a Decor prop (fit/sit); it is scenery, not gameplay cover, so it is not subject to the fairness gates.
